stat_title: Iraq's largest and most prestigious dental summit
stat_sub: What the first iSmile summit achieved in 2021.
ab_lead: iSmile is the largest and most prestigious international dental summit in Iraq. It began in 2021, when italk Foundation and the Kurdistan Dental Association brought science, clinical practice, industry and the dental community together in Kurdistan.
gal_lead: Moments from the first summit in Sulaymaniyah.
medx_p1: italkMedX is the medical branch of italk Organization, established in 2021 and officially registered under the Directorate of NGOs of the Kurdistan Regional Government.
medx_p2: Building on italk’s experience in education, leadership development, civic engagement, and professional capacity building, italkMedX is dedicated to advancing medical education, healthcare innovation, and professional collaboration. We create high-impact platforms that connect healthcare professionals, academic institutions, experts, students, and organizations to exchange knowledge, develop skills, and foster meaningful collaboration.
medx_p3: Through international summits, scientific conferences, advanced courses, specialized masterclasses, workshops, and professional forums, italkMedX provides opportunities for continuous learning, practical development, and knowledge exchange. Our work is driven by a commitment to empowering healthcare professionals, encouraging innovation, and creating meaningful connections that contribute to the advancement of healthcare and professional practice.
vis_p: To be the leading international dental summit in Iraq and the region: a world-class platform connecting Kurdistan and Iraq with global dental expertise.
mis_p: A premier meeting place where science meets practice, and local talent meets international expertise.
medx_p5: Alongside a growing portfolio of educational and professional initiatives.
exp_sub: Eight experiences over two days, from world-class lectures on the main stage to hands-on training.
bx1p: Keynotes by renowned international and local experts, advanced clinical sessions, case discussions and selected research presentations.
bx2p: Manufacturers, distributors, labs and technology companies.
bx3p: Hands-on training in procedures, materials and workflows.
bx4p: A live transmission of an advanced surgical procedure for hands-on, real-time learning.
bx5p: AI, intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM, 3D printing and robotics.
bx6p: Expert talks on education, standards, research and policy.
bx7p: Conversations with speakers, clinicians and innovators.
bx8p: Meetings between clinics, companies, labs and universities.
area_sub: Eight tracks covering the full range of modern dentistry.
ar1p: Implant planning, placement and surgical techniques.
ar2p: Crowns, bridges, veneers and full-mouth rehabilitation.
ar3p: Root canal treatment and gum health.
ar4p: Braces, aligners and children’s dental care.
ar5p: Smile design, whitening and cosmetic restorations.
ar6p: Diagnosis and care of oral diseases and lesions.
ar8p: AI tools for diagnosis and treatment planning.
